title.zh: 删除一个当前应用下的指定员工的应用账号
title.en: Delete an application account of a specified employee under the current application

descriptions.zh: 当前接口仅查询组织的直属权限，即直接分配给组织的应用。调用该接口时，可以通过 **ApplicationIds** 参数对应用进行筛选。
descriptions.en: This operation only queries the direct permissions of the organization, that is, applications directly assigned to the organization. When you call this operation, you can use the **ApplicationIds** parameter to filter applications.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam remove-application-account-from-user --instance-id eiam-111ccc1111 --application-id app_11111 --user-id user_example --application-account-id act_example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam RemoveApplicationAccountFromUser --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'eiam-111ccc1111' --UserId user_example --ApplicationId app_11111 --ApplicationAccountId act_example
